about: Cases of golden/cases.json the core cannot reproduce YET, and why.
The corpus is the contract of F11: every G# ticket closes when its cases
compare byte-identical against golden/metrics/. This file is what keeps CI
green in the meantime, and it is a checklist, not a carpet: a skipped case
is still RUN, and one that starts passing FAILS the suite asking to be
removed from here. Deleting your ticket's line is part of its exit criteria.
A reason names the capability that is missing and the ticket that lands it.
Where a case waits on several, the first named is the one whose exit
EMPTY since G13 (ZAB-146): every case of the corpus now reproduces its
metrics byte for byte against the core. Merging two branches that each
emptied a line of this file means taking the union of the DELETIONS, never
of the entries — the guard below catches that mistake, and has twice.
